title: claude-video teaches Claude any skill from a YouTube tutorial, free
description:
claude-video: https://github.com/bradautomates/claude-video

Every workflow you want is already on YouTube.

You just have to sit through it and take notes.

Then you forget half of it by Friday.

Transcripts alone don't fix that.

"Click here" means nothing without the screen.

claude-video shows Claude both.

It's free.

Drop in any YouTube tutorial.

It grabs the frames and the transcript.

Then hands Claude the pair.

So Claude sees what's on screen.

Not just what the person said.

Full context instead of a guess.

Then ask it to write the whole workflow.

Save that as a skill and reuse it forever.

Like having someone watch the tutorial for you.

They come back with the steps written down.

Stop taking notes on YouTube.

#claudevideo #claudecode #claude #youtube #aitools
